status: draft: judged rubric unreviewed; free checks run with `bun eval/runner/cat9-workflows.ts --checks`
about: Cat 9 user-workflow scenarios from a black-box audit of gbrain master 7ef3d53a47 (v0.60.753.0) on PGLite and Postgres 16. Each scenario has the Cat 9 judged fields (id, workflow, text, ground_truth_slugs, rubric with weight 1 or 2) and optional free fields: setup (gbrain CLI steps that build the brain) and checks (CLI calls with a fixed expectation, no judge). audit_setup and audit_checks keep the audit's original wording. known_failure names the audit finding a check failed on at the audited build; it labels the result and never turns a fail into a pass. All names in the corpus are placeholders.

sources.note: run `gbrain sources unfederate work` after add; add defaults to federated

fixture.puts: corpus/puts holds page bodies that scenarios save with `gbrain put`
fixture.free_run: each scenario gets fresh keyword-only PGLite brains (gbrain init --pglite, no provider key) and its own copy of the corpus
